title: Printing Industry
description: Advanced ERP solutions tailored for printing companies, optimizing print production workflows, color management and quality control while ensuring efficient material utilization and timely delivery.

infoCards.title: Print Jobs
infoCards.description: Streamlined management of print jobs from estimation to delivery.

infoCards.title: Color Control
infoCards.description: Precise color management and quality assurance system.

faqData.question: How does the system handle print job management?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive print job management including estimating, scheduling, material planning, press allocation and real-time production tracking with automated workflow management.

faqData.question: What color management features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes advanced color management with color profile handling, calibration tracking, color quality control and compliance with industry color standards.

faqData.question: Can it manage material inventory and costs?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution manages material inventory with paper stock management, ink consumption tracking, automated reordering and detailed job costing with waste monitoring.
